summary: BiomX filed an 8-K regarding an amendment to a promissory note issued to Water IO Ltd. as partial consideration for a prior acquisition. The amendment extends the maturity date from July 10, 2026 to November 1, 2026, and restructures repayment into a $250,000 immediate payment followed by four monthly $250,000 installments, with 800,000 restricted shares issued as interest and waiver consideration. This is a routine debt modification, not a standalone special situation event. No material change in corporate control, strategic direction, or capital structure beyond this note adjustment is indicated. The filing is ordinary-course and lacks the hallmarks of an activist campaign, strategic review, or other special-situation category.
